channel.title: Just the News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just the News (justthenews.com)

item.title: House Democrat accused of stealing $5 million from FEMA posts edited photo without expensive ring
item.description: Cherfilus-McCormick's official House portrait shows the congresswoman wearing a flashy yellow diamond ring, but the photo that was posted on Christmas does not feature the jewelry. A Community Notes on the post flags the missing ring.

item.title: More than 260 Tren de Aragua leaders and members have been federally indicted under Trump
item.description: Trump designated TdA as an Foreign Terrorist Organization for the first time in U.S. history in February and directed the Department of Justice and other federal agencies to eradicate it from the U.S.

item.title: Trump preparing landmark new policy to spur up to 12 million new and affordable homes, adviser says
item.description: Housing costs are a major part of the "affordability" issue facing many Americans. President Trump is hoping his new plans will relieve much of that financial pressure.

item.title: Prior to missile attack, Trump increased monitoring violent anti-Christian operations in Nigeria
item.description: Rep. Andrew Clyde, R-Ga. “The ongoing violence against Christians in Nigeria is one of the most egregious violations of human rights and religious freedom so far this century.”

item.title: Audit: One-in-five employees at Energy Department loan office had potential conflicts of interest
item.description: During budget hearings in May, Energy Secretary Chris Wright warned that the Biden-Harris administration was pushing out billions in loans without proper controls. This is the same office that provided failed solar startup Solyndra with a $535 million loan guarantee under Obama.

item.title: Blue states created an election trimester for ballots, now conservatives are pushing back
item.description: Look for wild vote count fluctuation for days after polls close. Counteroffensives include an executive order by President Trump, followed by a challenge to Mississippi's counting process that has not reached the U.S. Supreme Court. Ohio's legislature voted to require all its ballots to arrive on election night to be tallied.

item.title: Mother of California child Melodee Buzzard found dead in Utah pleads not guilty to murder charge
item.description: The mother, Ashlee Buzzard, entered a not guilty plea inside a California courtroom Friday morning.

item.title: California 2nd most expensive state in the country for raising a child, trails only Hawaii: Study
item.description: According to the study, Californians need to earn at least $97,656 a year to be able to afford a child and one stay-at-home parent, while working couples with children have to earn together at least $115,814 a year to pay for housing, transportation, child care and other essential expenses.

item.title: Nurses Union, elected officials push back against limits on loans for nursing students
item.description: Students pursuing a master's degree or doctorate in nursing will be limited to $100,000 in total borrowing costs, much like students pursuing degrees in liberal arts and other areas not categorized as professional.

item.title: AGs says anti-fossil fuel alliance may be in violation of antitrust and consumer protection laws.
item.description: “Instead of focusing on things like lower energy costs or strengthening the American economy, As You Sow’s only priority is to reshape the energy sector to meet senseless net-zero benchmarks,” Hild said.
